# Logo

Displays WK product and brand logos.

## When to Use

- Application headers
- Login screens
- Footer branding
- About pages

## Jumpstart Implementation

| Jumpstart Component | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| `Logo` | WK logo display |

For code examples and API details, use the Jumpstart MCP tools:
- `get-jumpstart-components-apis` with `["Logo"]`
- `get-jumpstart-components-examples` with `["Logo"]`
